english.note: Use this everyday phrase when the messenger is simply a person passing on what someone said rather than a professional courier.

examples.english: Be the messenger and tell Mum I won't be home for dinner tonight.
examples.traditional: 你做傳話嘅人，同阿媽講我今晚唔返嚟食飯。
